topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The air is thick with the scent of waiting, a shared breath held by all who linger. The sun, a gentle hand, touches the edges of the day, urging it to slow. In this space, where time seems to have forgotten its pace, I find myself close to you, not by measure of feet or inches, but in the quiet understanding that passes between us. Your eyes, pools of restless thought, carry a weight that I, too, bear in my silence. I stand, a steady presence, willing the moments to mend, to weave back the fabric of plans torn by unforeseen winds. Together, in this pause, we find a strength, a gentle holding that speaks without words, a bridge over the chasm of what has been and what will be.
